page.layout: One printed page, single column of dictionary entries (Hebrew, Chaldee, Latin glosses) with running head at top, page number at top right; no marginal notes; a catchword "בר" at the lower right.

main_text.p: בקי, בקי כסן Ch. & Syr. Probatus, exercitatus. Plur. בקיאין, בקין. Fœmin. בקין בהלכה Exercitati in ritibus, Genef.49.12. in Targ.Hierosol.
בקע Ch.Fidit,scidit,discidit. Ithpeh. אתבקע Scindi, discindi, דאתבקעו כרסיהון Quorum ventres seu uteri dissecti sunt, Threm.1.16.
בקעא Ch. Vallis, Planities, planum, pratum. emph. בקעתא.
בקק בקיקין Chald. Frusta, fragmenta, טעורת פחרא Idola testacea redigebantur in frusta, Num.33.4. in Jon. Forte legendum בקיעין.
בקר Pahel Chald. Quærere, Inquirere, Disquirere, requirere; Visitare (ægrotos sc.) ut Deut.34.6.in Jon. Ithpah. Fut. יתבקר Perquiratur, Esræ 5.17.
בקרא Ch.Grex, Armetum, Syr. כסבן Grex porcorum, Luc.8.32. Plur. בקרין, בקרי Deuter. 7.13. & fœmin. בקרן Jesa.7.25. & 65.10.
בקרותא Ch. Bubile, Stabulum, Genef.18.7. in T.Jon.
בקורתא Ch. Flagellatio quæ fit cum loro bovino, Levit.19.20.
בר ברא Ch.& Syr.Filius: בר בר Filius filii,id est,Nepos. Fœmin. ברת, ברתא, ברתא Filia.

page.notes: The Hebrew and Chaldee vowel-pointed forms are transcribed as closely as the scan allows; some pointing and the small Syriac/Hebrew fragments in lines of the first entries are uncertain. The Hebrew word-forms in the entry "הל" and the lines beginning "כסבן" are doubtful.
